NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author says Daniel K confirmed this extends the filters from #24200, so the design hold is lifted, and asks to move to "maintainer review". There has been no new push since the feedback, so the description and commits are as they were.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | The design question is settled: Daniel K said on CZO that the PR isn't blocked on the resolved-topics discussion. |
| ❌  | The description still needs work: the "Fixes:" line is empty, the issue link is written as `Fixes #<36878>`, and the "remaining decisions" and "corner cases" checklist items are unchecked. |
| ❌  | Two commits ("Trigger fresh CI run…", "Retry after ShellCheck mirror timeout") are CI retries, not coherent changes, so commit discipline isn't met. |
| ℹ️  | The PR is large (+106/-21, 11 files). It also turns the search input into a `contenteditable` container, which is a separate change from the `is:followed` filter. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and don't add "maintainer review" yet. Ask the author to fix the description and clean up the commits first.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for checking in with Daniel, and good to know the design isn't blocking this. Before it can go to review, please fix the description (a proper `Fixes: #36878` line, plus the unchecked checklist items) and squash the CI-retry commits into the real ones, following the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html). We'll take another look once that's pushed.
```
